proof_summary: For \(n=67\), the two distinct values \(m=147\) and \(m=2055\) both have \(\sum_{k=1}^{\lfloor\log_2 m\rfloor}(m\bmod 2^k)=67\): their residue lists are respectively \((1,3,3,3,19,19,19)\) and \((1,3,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7,7)\). Thus there are at least two occurrences, contradicting the claimed uniqueness.
